name: AOP Kid Hooded Towel
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from soft and absorbent microfiber polyester, this AOP Kid Hooded Towel is gentle on delicate skin while providing quick-drying comfort after every swim, bath, or beach adventure. 
  • The cozy hooded design helps keep kids warm and dry, while the lightweight fabric ensures breathable everyday use.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
  • Please follow the size specifications for S, M, and L as shown in the size chart.
  • Suitable for kids ages 4–10
  • Please allow a size tolerance of ±1–3 cm due to manual measurement.

 

Printing Technology:
  • Designed with  sublimation technology, the towel features vibrant, high-resolution colors and long-lasting details that resist fading after washing. 
  • The full-print coverage creates a fun and eye-catching personalized look kids will love.

 

Functionality Use:
  • Perfect for bath time, swimming lessons, beach trips, pool parties, and vacations. 
  • The poncho-style design allows easy slip-on wear, while side buttons provide a secure and comfortable fit. 
  • Its highly absorbent and quick-drying fabric helps dry hair and body efficiently after water activities.
     
Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A fun and practical gift for birthdays, summer vacations, holidays, beach lovers, and family trips. Personalize it with unique designs or names to create a special keepsake for kids who love swimming and adventure.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and information updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
